Saga.label: An order saga
Saga.caption: A saga keeps an order consistent across services without one big transaction. Each service commits its own step; when one fails, the steps before it are undone by compensating actions.
Saga.outcome: Payment declined. Stock released and order cancelled.

Story.title: Every upgrade starts with one command.
Story.summary: A terminal shows the migration I ran at Sisal: a proof of concept for Spring Boot 2.x to 3.x and Java 11 to 21, then every module moved to Java 21, more than 30 in all.
Story.outro: From a proof of concept to every module.
